title: Stable 0.4.0 hardening and release qualification
implementation_plan: Add a dedicated CAPABILITY_INVALID recovery path before writes that calls owner-checked next_task(run_id), returns a fresh capability as recoverable correction, applies zero writes and never validates or revokes the malformed token as authority.
Add negative tests for single-character mutation, truncation, cross-run, cross-owner, revoked/stale/expired capabilities, writes_applied=0 and non-replay semantics.
Carry complete_flow_locally_validated into RuntimeToolBackend construction and expose the exact same value through server_info and gateway HTTP metadata.
Relax preview/stable command-layout validation from symlink-only to accepted executable identity for ~/.cargo/bin/mtm while keeping the versioned selector and rollback release hash-bound.

After source gates pass, freeze version 0.4.0, build the exact stable artifact, validate clean GitHub install and copied existing-state upgrade, run real proof finalization, selector rollback/recutover and bounded soak, then append the final receipt.

acceptance.A0: Full format, warnings-denied Clippy, workspace tests, governance and unified local gate pass.
acceptance.A1: Capability error taxonomy remains deterministic and stable; only CAPABILITY_INVALID before writes gets a fresh envelope and no malformed token gains write authority.
acceptance.A3: Cross-owner/run, revoked, stale, expired and verifier/finalizer firewalls remain fail-closed; no secret token is logged or persisted in release evidence.
acceptance.A4: Clean public install, existing-state upgrade, P3 default/P2 override, proof_verified.tex finalization, stable selector rollback and recutover pass on the supported Linux target.
acceptance.A5: Bounded stable-release soak/resource checks pass without unexplained process/thread/fd/state growth; no new performance claim is required.

rollback: Keep preview.3 installed and selected until stable qualification passes. After stable deployment, atomically restore preview.3 if needed; no persistent data or verified artifacts are rewritten.
